query:
SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ventures) as total_ventures,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ventures WHERE status = 'In progress') as active_ventures,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tasks WHERE status != 'complete' AND dueDate IS NOT NULL AND dueDate < CURDATE()) as overdue_tasks,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tasks WHERE status != 'complete') as open_tasks,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM team_members) as team_count
